common.notFoundBody: The link may be old, or the sheet may have been merged into another.
common.errorBody: The incident has been recorded. You can try again straight away.

brand.disclaimer: {brand} is an information site. No tobacco product is sold on it.

statistics.title: Your figures
statistics.body: Your pace over twelve months, and the cigars you come back to.

home.title: The cigar reference, written by the people who smoke them.

ageGate.title: What is your date of birth?
ageGate.lede: This site is about tobacco products. The law restricts access to adults. Your date of birth is used for that check and nothing else.
ageGate.label: Date of birth

errors.required: Please enter your date of birth.
errors.underage: Access to this site is restricted to adults.
errors.implausible: That date of birth is not plausible.

ageGate.privacy: The date is not kept unless you have an account. A signed cookie remembers only that the check took place.

health.notice: Smoking seriously harms you and others around you.
health.title: Tobacco and health
health.lede: Tobacco is the leading cause of avoidable death in France. This is a site of information and documentation: it promotes no consumption.
health.helpBody: Tabac info service — 39 89, Monday to Saturday. Free and confidential support.

legal.placeholder: This document is being drafted and will be reviewed by legal counsel before the site opens to the public.
legal.dsaMechanism: Every sheet, every comment and every shop product carries a “Report” button. It opens a case in our queue, with the reason you pick and whatever you add to it. It asks you to sign in, because the decision is communicated to whoever reported.
legal.dsaDeadline: We review every notice within {hours} hours and communicate the decision to its author. A decision to take content down is reasoned and can be appealed.
legal.dsaContactPending: The single point of contact required by articles 11 and 12 of the Digital Services Act will be published here before the site opens to the public. Until then, the notice form above is the mechanism article 16 provides for.

facets.title: Refine
facets.completenessHint: To find what is missing rather than put up with it: each entry lists the sheets that lack that fact — which is where a sourced proposal counts.
facets.aromaHint: The eleven families of the wheel. The exact descriptor is picked on the wheel itself.

results.noneHint: Widen the criteria, or clear the filters.
results.emptyTitle: The reference is not open to the public yet
results.emptyBody: The sheets are in the database but none has been reviewed. A sheet is only visible once a reviewer has checked it: that is the rule of the reference, not a temporary display limit.
results.lede: {total} published sheets · {withVitola} with a vitola · {withStrength} with a strength · {withAromas} with an aroma profile — the rest is waiting for your corrections.

cigar.priceNote: Set retail price, applicable on {date}. Source: decree published in the Journal officiel. For information only.
cigar.notFound: This sheet does not exist, or is not published yet.
cigar.shadeStep: shade {n} of 6, from claro to oscuro
cigar.aromasLede: What comes back from one box to the next, according to the reference.
cigar.priceSource: Decree published in the Journal officiel. For information only.
cigar.aromasFromMakerLede: Transcribed from the page the maker publishes — the source is one click away.

brand.noCigars: No published sheet for this brand.

vitola.noCigars: No published sheet for this vitola.

card.sparse: Format, strength and wrapper not recorded.

teaser.title: The full reference is for members
teaser.body: Here are {shown} sheets out of {total}. The search, the facets, the comparator and the members’ ratings open with an account — free of charge.
teaser.cta: Create an account or sign in

auth.title: Sign in
auth.lede: Enter your address and your password. If you have none, ask for a sign-in link: it arrives by e-mail and signs you in without a password.
auth.sentBody: Open the e-mail sent to {email} and follow the link. It works once, and for an hour.
auth.privacy: Your address identifies you and does nothing else. No marketing, ever.

errors.email: That address does not look valid.
errors.link: That link has expired. Ask for a new one.
errors.rate: Too many requests. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
errors.unknown: Sending failed. Try again in a moment.
errors.passwordRequired: Enter your password, or ask for a sign-in link.

hero.lede: A reference, a notebook, a humidor. Kept by the people who smoke.

plate.alt: Plate: a lit cigar seen from the side, the ash and the ember to the left, the band at the right third, a thread of smoke rising.

comments.title: Comments
comments.rule: A comment informs; it does not praise. Anything that urges consumption is taken down.
comments.emptyBody: Say what you know about this cigar: how it is built, how it smokes, or what this sheet states and does not match.
comments.formHint: 2,000 characters at most. What you write is visible to everyone.
comments.signInBody: Reading is open to everyone; writing needs an account.

errors.unknown: The comment could not be saved.

comments.discussionLede: What is said about the sheet itself — a construction, a smoke, a figure that does not match. To rate the cigar, that is the notebook.
comments.signInLine: Reading is open to everyone; writing needs an account.

notebook.title: My notebook
notebook.lede: What you smoked, when, and what you made of it. Each entry chooses who may read it, and the choice is made entry by entry.
notebook.emptyBody: An entry is created from a cigar's sheet: the rating, the date, and whatever you want to keep of it. Nothing is published until you decide it is.
notebook.emptyFilteredBody: That filter returns nothing for now. Drop it to get the whole notebook back.
notebook.sharedWithMeLede: The entries other members have opened to you by name.
notebook.sharedWithMeEmpty: Nobody has named you on an entry yet.

entry.deleteConfirm: Delete this entry for good? The thirds and the shares attached to it go with it.

scope.hint: The choice is made entry by entry, and can be changed at any time.
scope.privateHint: Nobody else sees it. That is the notebook's default.
scope.sharedHint: You pick the members, one by one. They cannot share it on.
scope.sharedPending: Save the entry first: the recipients are named afterwards, from the entry itself.
scope.followersHint: The audience is alive: it grows after you choose.
scope.followersWarning: Today's followers are not the ones you will have in six months. An entry opened to twelve people will be readable by three hundred if you gain that many, without being asked again.
scope.followersOpen: Following is free: somebody can join that audience without asking you. You can remove a follower from your profile — their future reading closes, what they have already read stays read.
scope.publicHint: Visible on the cigar's sheet, including to a signed-out visitor.
scope.publicCounts: Only public entries go into a cigar's mean.
scope.currentShared: Readable by {count} person(s) you have named

form.body: What you take away from it
form.bodyHint: 4,000 characters at most. Optional if you give a rating.
form.signInTitle: Sign in to keep a notebook
form.signInBody: The notebook is personal: it needs an account. What you write there stays private by default.

tasting.title: Tasting {cigar}
tasting.lede: The exercise, as opposed to the gesture: the three thirds, the six criteria, the aromas picked off the wheel. Nothing is required except the six ratings, which make the overall one.
tasting.stepScoresHint: Each out of 10, in half-points. Their mean makes the overall rating and is not typed by hand: that is what tells a tasting from a rating thrown down.
tasting.totalPending: Rate the six criteria to get the overall rating.
tasting.stepThirdsHint: What the cigar does in the first, the second and the last third. Optional, third by third.
tasting.stepAromasHint: Pick them on the wheel. 30 descriptors at most.
tasting.stepContextHint: What you will remember in two years, and what explains the rating.
tasting.blindHint: You did not know what you were smoking. The mention counts: it changes what the rating is worth.
tasting.timerHint: The timer fills the duration in. You can also write it straight in.
tasting.pairingHint: What you were drinking, 500 characters at most.
tasting.draftRestored: A draft was found on this device and reloaded.
tasting.draftHint: What you type is kept on this device until you save. It does not leave your browser.

shares.title: People named
shares.lede: They alone can read this entry, besides you. They cannot share it on.
shares.empty: You have not named anybody yet.
shares.searchHint: Two characters at least. A member who has left the directory does not appear.
shares.removeNote: Removing somebody closes future access. It does not undo what they have already read.
shares.onlyWhenShared: This list only matters when the scope is “people I name”.

errors.unknown: The entry could not be saved.
errors.notAllowed: Your account does not allow this.
errors.notFound: This entry does not exist, or is not open to you.
errors.emptyLog: A notebook entry needs at least a rating or a comment.
errors.scoreRange: The rating goes from 1 to 5 bands.
errors.durationRange: The duration goes from 1 to 600 minutes.
errors.tastingIncomplete: A tasting needs all six criteria.
errors.dateFuture: One does not rate a cigar one has not smoked yet.
errors.shareUnknown: That member could not be named.

cigarStats.title: Members’ ratings
cigarStats.emptyBody: Nobody has published a rating for this cigar. Yours would be the first — and it only counts if you make it public.
cigarStats.bayesianHint: Bayesian mean: a cigar rated once does not outrank a cigar rated thirty times.
cigarStats.recentNone: No rating in the last 90 days.
cigarStats.entriesEmpty: No entry to show on this sheet.
cigarStats.emptyLine: No public rating. Yours would be the first — it only counts if you make it public.
cigarStats.citedAromasHint: In the members’ public entries — a different fact from the reference profile above, and never mixed with it.
cigarStats.hint: Bayesian mean: a cigar rated once does not outrank a cigar rated thirty times. Only public entries count here.

report.title: Report this content
report.lede: Say what the problem is. A moderator reviews every report within {hours} hours.
report.sentBody: A moderator will review it within {hours} hours. You will be told the decision.
report.duplicate: You have already reported this content; the case is open.
report.throttled: Too many reports in a short time. Try again in an hour.
report.ageGate: The 18+ gate has to be passed before reporting. You will come back here afterwards.
report.gone: This content is no longer visible.
report.error: The report could not be sent. Try again.

desk.title: The report queue
desk.lede: Every report is reviewed within {hours} hours — the deadline published in the legal notice — and the queue is worked oldest first.
desk.restrictedBody: This queue is worked by moderator accounts. If something looks wrong to you, the « Report » button is on every sheet, entry, post, review, product and partner — that button is what fills this queue.
desk.emptyOpenBody: The queue is empty. Reports land here as soon as someone uses « Report ».
desk.emptyDecidedBody: Decisions and their reasons will be found here.

case.targetGone: Not found or withdrawn — deleted by its author, or out of reading reach.
case.actAdminProduct: Withdraw this product from sale, from the admin area
case.actAdminVendor: Suspend this partner, from the admin area
case.decideLede: The decision is final on this case: a challenge goes through a new report, which can restore hidden content.
case.dismiss: Dismissed — nothing wrong with the content
case.noteHint: Required: a decision without reasons cannot be contested (DSA, art. 17). 2,000 characters at most.
case.actUnavailable: This surface has no hiding columns: the decision is recorded here, and any action takes its own path — a wiki revision, the venue's status, withdrawing a product or suspending a partner from the admin area.
case.actReasonHint: Written on the hidden content and in the moderation log. Required in order to hide.
case.confirm: Decide this case? The decision cannot be changed afterwards.

done.acknowledged: Case taken — it moves to in review.
done.decided: Case decided. The decision and its reasons are in the moderation log.

errors.noteRequired: Reasons are required: a decision without reasons cannot be contested.
errors.alreadyDecided: This case has already been decided — a challenge goes through a new report.
errors.targetGone: The content reported no longer exists. Decide without an action.
errors.notHideable: This surface cannot be hidden. Decide without an action.
errors.generic: The decision could not be recorded. Try again.

desk.settingsLede: The DSA queue at /moderation, for moderator accounts.

admin.title: Administration
admin.lede: What the site cannot yet do on its own: the flags, the accounts, the review of the sheets and the lines. The work queues — moderation, wiki, venues, journal — each keep their own screen; from here, you go to them.
admin.restrictedBody: This section requires the administrator role. Every gesture it allows is checked again by the database anyway: reaching it without the role would let you write nowhere.
admin.settingsLede: Flags, accounts, review of the sheets, lines.

dash.flagsLede: What the site offers or holds back, without a deployment.
dash.shopLede: The state of the shop at a glance: the flag, the review queue, the partners. Everything is managed from the two screens below.
dash.shopCatalogueLabel: products in the catalogue, {published} of them published

flagsScreen.title: The feature flags
flagsScreen.lede: Every change goes through a door that writes its trace to the audit log, in the same transaction — a flag changed without a history does not exist here. A flag is born in a migration, with the code that reads it: nothing is created on this screen.
flagsScreen.saved: Saved, and traced to the audit log.
flagsScreen.unknownFlag: Flag not listed by this screen — its original description:

public_signup_open.label: Public sign-up
public_signup_open.description: Opens account creation to any visitor of age. Closed until legal advice (Q1) is given.
public_signup_open.warning: Opening it changes who can come in: that is an opening decision, not a setting. Tighten the comment threshold first, and make sure somebody is working the moderation queue.

show_indicative_prices.label: Indicative prices
show_indicative_prices.description: Displays the approved price (msrp_eur) on the sheets. Off by default: a price put forward is an invitation to buy within the meaning of the loi Évin.

wiki_contributions_open.label: Wiki contribution
wiki_contributions_open.description: Opens the queue of proposed corrections on the sheets.

comments_min_role.label: Comment threshold
comments_min_role.description: The minimum role for commenting on a sheet. To be tightened to « contributor » the day sign-up opens.

dsa_report_sla_hours.label: Report handling deadline
dsa_report_sla_hours.description: The deadline announced in the legal notice, read on every render.
dsa_report_sla_hours.warning: This number is a published commitment: changing it changes what the site promises, immediately and without a deployment.

venues_enabled.label: The places
venues_enabled.description: The whole /lieux section, navigation entry included. The payload lists the kinds offered; restricting it after legal advice (Q6) is done here — the kinds themselves are edited in a migration.

shop_enabled.label: The public shop
shop_enabled.description: The whole /boutique section: search, product sheets and the demonstration purchase funnel. The marketplace was withdrawn on 12 September 2026 (migration 0034): there is no vendor storefront any more, we resell what we buy.
shop_enabled.warning: Opening it is the commercial opening gesture: the catalogue becomes visible to every visitor, with no till as long as the Stripe keys are missing.

accounts.title: The accounts
accounts.lede: Every profile, discoverable or not — it is the moderators' policy that opens this. Promoting a role is done on the member's profile, where the panel already exists; suspending has no arm yet (ADR 0013), and erasure remains the GDPR gesture of the account holder.
accounts.emptyBody: The search covers the handle and the display name.
accounts.countNote: The {count} most recent accounts. Narrow it down with the search beyond that.
accounts.invitationsLede: These addresses will receive their role at their first sign-in — a magic link to their e-mail is enough. Promoting an account that already exists is done from its profile.

sheets.title: The review of the sheets
sheets.lede: 862 sheets were published for QA with no human review. Reviewing means checking a sheet against its source and saying so: « mark reviewed » signs verified_by and timestamps verified_at. Unpublishing takes a sheet out of public reading without erasing anything; the wiki history stays.
sheets.emptyBody: That is the right state for « not reviewed »: it will mean the backlog is cleared — and that proposing a new sheet (ADR 0008) can open.

lines.title: The lines
lines.lede: A line is born here as a draft, invisible to the public, and is published by a separate gesture — even for the person who has just created it. It is attached to sheets through the contribution queue, never in bulk. One verifiable source per line: that is the reference's provenance rule.
lines.created: Line created, as a draft. Publishing it is the gesture next door.
lines.deleteConfirm: Delete this line? The sheets attached to it will simply be detached.
lines.emptyBody: The table is empty by a v1 decision, reopened by ADR 0009: the first lines are created here, with a verifiable source, and published once reviewed.

confirmations.relue: Sheet marked reviewed, signed by your account.
confirmations.depubliee: Sheet unpublished. It stays in the reference, invisible to the public.
confirmations.gammePubliee: Line published. It can now be proposed in the wiki.
confirmations.gammeDepubliee: Line unpublished. The sheets already attached no longer display it.
confirmations.gammeSupprimee: Line deleted. The sheets attached have been detached.
confirmations.refus: The database refused this gesture: it requires a role this account does not have.
confirmations.produitPublie: Product published. It is on the public shelf.
confirmations.produitRefuse: Product refused, reason recorded on the draft.
confirmations.vendeurSuspendu: Partner stopped. The products already bought stay on sale: the stock is ours.

errors.notAdmin: This gesture requires the administrator role.
errors.flagUnknown: This flag does not exist. A flag is born in a migration, with the code that reads it.
errors.hoursRange: The deadline is counted in hours, between 1 and 720.
errors.lineNameNeeded: A line needs a name with at least one letter or digit.
errors.lineExists: This brand already has a line at that address.
errors.unknown: This action did not go through.
errors.titleRefused: This title, this brand or this description names a tobacco product: the catalogue sells accessories only (§2).
errors.priceRange: The price is counted in euros, between 0.01 and 99,999.
errors.stockRange: Stock is a positive whole number.
errors.imageInvalid: The image must be WebP, JPEG, PNG or AVIF, and weigh 8 MB at most.
errors.productExists: A product already carries this title — its address would be the same.
errors.productTitleNeeded: A product needs a title of at least two characters, with letters or digits.
errors.brandLen: The brand is between 2 and 80 characters.
errors.vendorNameNeeded: A partner needs a name with at least one letter or digit.
errors.vendorExists: A partner already carries this name — its address would be the same.
errors.refuseNoteNeeded: A refusal is given reasons: the reason stays on the draft.
errors.vendorNeeded: Choose the partner this item was bought from.
errors.vendorHasProducts: This partner still has products: stopping is the normal verb, deleting is the gesture for an empty one.

shop.title: The shop catalogue
shop.lede: Accessories, nothing else: the closed category is §2's first barrier, the lexical check the second — a product that names tobacco is refused on screen and by the database. A product is born a draft; « published » puts it on the public shelf immediately — the shop is open, only the payment is a demonstration.
shop.stockHint: Declarative until payment: automatic decrementing arrives with the first sale.
shop.imageHint: WebP, JPEG, PNG or AVIF, 8 MB at most. It replaces the current one.
shop.deleteConfirm: Delete this product and its image? The day orders exist, deletion will become archiving — today nothing refers to it.
shop.emptyBody: The first product is created above: a title, a category, a price. A published product is on the shelf at once: the shop is open to the public, and only the payment is a demonstration.
shop.vendorHint: Who this item was bought from. Optional — it is accounting information, never shown to a visitor.
shop.brandHint: Who makes it — optional. The partner is who we buy from: two questions, two columns.
shop.queueEmpty: Nothing to review: no draft is waiting. A submitted draft lands here, oldest first.
shop.refuseNoteHint: The reason stays on the draft, so that one knows what to correct.
shop.vendorsLede: Those we buy from. No account, no storefront: the shop resells.

review.title: Reviewing in series
review.lede: One sheet at a time, its waiting proposals, and two keys. Accepting applies it to the sheet; refusing asks for a word, which only the author will read. Freshness, the trace and the rights are those of the queue: nothing here decides differently from /contributions.
review.restrictedBody: Reviewing requires the reviewer (editor) role. It is granted by hand, by an administrator, from a profile.
review.filterHint: « With a source » keeps only the proposals that cite a page or a document: those are the ones that can be checked in one click.
review.emptyBody: The queue is empty under this filter. That is the right state, as long as someone comes to put something back in it.
review.sheetGone: This sheet has no proposal waiting any more: here is the next one.
review.shortcutReject: refuse — the word for the author is typed first, then Ctrl + Enter
review.sourceNone: No source cited — to be checked another way.

partners.title: The partners
partners.lede: Those we buy from. A partner has neither an account nor a storefront: since 12 September 2026 the shop resells, and nobody sells here but us.
partners.emptyBody: Add the one you buy from: the product sheets attach to it.
partners.suspendConfirm: Stop buying from this partner? The products already bought stay on sale: the stock is ours.
partners.deleteConfirm: Delete this empty partner? A partner that has products is stopped, not deleted.

aromas.title: Aroma wheel
aromas.lede: Eleven families, seventy-six descriptors. It is the vocabulary of a tasting — and the way into the reference by taste.
aromas.emptyTitle: The wheel is not loaded yet
aromas.emptyBody: The aroma nomenclature arrives with the reference data.
aromas.wheelHint: Pick a family on the outer ring, then a descriptor: the list takes you to the sheets that carry it.

humidor.title: My humidor
humidor.lede: What you keep, since when, and what is left of it. Your humidor is visible to you alone.
humidor.emptyBody: A humidor is created with a name. You will then put cigars in it from their sheet, or by importing an inventory you already keep elsewhere.
humidor.emptyLotsBody: Find a cigar below to put it in. You will give the quantity, the price paid and the date it went in — everything is optional but the quantity.
humidor.createLede: A name is enough. The capacity fills a gauge and refuses nothing: one does not invent cigars one has not bought, and one does not hide the ones one has.
humidor.name: Name
humidor.isDefaultHint: The one offered first from a cigar's sheet.
humidor.deleteConfirm: Delete this humidor? Its lots, its ledger and its readings go with it. Your notebook entries stay.
humidor.lotsLede: One lot per purchase: two boxes of the same cigar share neither an age nor a price.
humidor.rotationHint: In the humidor for over eighteen months and never started.
humidor.emptyLotHint: The lot stays: it remembers what you paid and how long you had it.
humidor.addLede: Find the sheet, then say how many you are putting in.
humidor.searchNoResult: No sheet matches. Try the brand alone, or browse the reference.
humidor.priceHint: For one cigar, not for the box.
humidor.agingStartHint: The date on the box, if you know it. It may precede the purchase: a box bought aged has been resting since before you.
humidor.smokeLede: The stock drops and the notebook entry is written in the same movement. You can note nothing: the event alone says you smoked it.
humidor.smokeBodyPlaceholder: Optional. With no rating and no word, nothing goes into the notebook.
humidor.smokeDoneWithEntry: Taken out, and noted in your notebook.
humidor.eventLede: The ledger is not scratched out: a miscount is corrected by an adjustment, never by erasing a line.
humidor.eventAdjustHint: Negative if some are missing, positive if there are more than expected.
humidor.ledgerEmpty: Nothing has left this lot yet.
humidor.readingsLede: What the hygrometer says, when you read it. V1 only records readings typed by hand.
humidor.readingsEmpty: No reading. The first gives a point; the third gives a trend.
humidor.csvLede: The file names each cigar by its URL identifier, not by an internal number: one must be able to read it somewhere other than here.
humidor.csvImportHint: Expected columns: cigar_slug and qty at least. The import creates lots; it does not correct a stock.
humidor.notLinkedTitle: Not taken out of your humidor yet
humidor.notLinkedBody: This tasting has no humidor movement. If the cigar came from one of your lots, say so here: the stock will drop by one.
humidor.notLinkedAction: Take it out of my humidor
humidor.linkedBody: Taken out of your humidor on {date}.

errors.nameTooLong: That name is too long (80 characters at most).
errors.capacityRange: The capacity must be a number of cigars between 1 and 100,000.
errors.qtyRange: The quantity must be a whole number, and not zero.
errors.priceRange: The price must be between 0 and 1,000,000 €.
errors.vendorTooLong: That seller's name is too long (120 characters at most).
errors.boxCodeTooLong: That box code is too long (40 characters at most).
errors.positionTooLong: That position is too long (60 characters at most).
errors.notesTooLong: Those notes are too long (2,000 characters at most).
errors.scoreRange: The rating goes from 1 to 5 bands.
errors.bodyTooLong: That comment is too long (4,000 characters at most).
errors.dateFuture: That date is in the future.
errors.emptyReading: A reading needs at least a humidity or a temperature.
errors.notEnoughStock: There are only {count} left in that lot.
errors.alreadyDefault: You already have a default humidor.
errors.csvHeader: The header must contain at least cigar_slug and qty.
errors.csvTooLong: That file is over {max} rows. Import it in several passes.
errors.csvUnknownSlug: These identifiers do not exist in the reference: {slugs}.
errors.csvBadQty: The quantity on row {line} is not a valid whole number.
errors.unknown: That action did not go through.

humidor.deleteLotConfirm: Delete this lot? Its ledger goes with it, and with it the record of what you smoked. A used-up lot can stay: it costs nothing and it remembers.
humidor.smokeLotHint: If this cigar comes from one of your lots, the stock will drop by one when the tasting is saved. You can also do it afterwards, from the entry.

statistics.title: My figures
statistics.lede: What you smoked, when, at what pace. Only your own entries and your own humidors count here.
statistics.emptyBody: One notebook entry, or one cigar taken out of your humidor, and this page fills itself.
statistics.meanScoreHint: Over your rated entries, in bands, whatever their scope.
statistics.smokedHint: Counted from the ledger, so including the ones you did not rate.
statistics.rhythmLede: The last twelve months, by month of consumption.
statistics.rhythmEmpty: Not enough dates yet to draw a pace.
statistics.topLede: The cigars that come back most in your notebook.
statistics.topEmpty: It takes two entries on the same cigar for a ranking to mean anything.
statistics.stockValueUnknown: Value unknown: no price is recorded.
statistics.scopeNote: These figures count your entries whatever their scope — this is your notebook, not what other people see of it.
statistics.truncated: These figures cover your 5,000 most recent entries. Beyond that the page stops counting everything — and says so rather than letting you believe otherwise.

settings.title: My account
settings.lede: Who you are here, what you prefer to see, what others will see of you, and what you can take away or erase.
settings.profileLede: What identifies you to other members. Nothing is required but the handle.
settings.handleHint: Lowercase letters, digits and underscores. It was given to you at sign-up from your identifier: it is the first setting most people change.
settings.displayNameHint: What is read under your entries. Failing that, your handle.
settings.isDiscoverableHint: Unticked, you disappear from what other members can look up: the signature under your comments, the recipient search of the notebook. It is a choice we honour, not a cosmetic setting.
settings.roleHint: Role and reputation are not changed from here, nor from anywhere else: they are outside every client write right.
settings.preferencesLede: How figures are shown to you. Nothing below changes what is recorded.
settings.emailDigestHint: No such e-mail exists yet. This is a preference recorded ahead of time, and it will be honoured the day there is one.
settings.privacyLede: What other members see of you, on your public profile. All three have been honoured since P3; what they do is not the same thing, and that is said under each one.
settings.showHumidorHint: Unticked by default, and the only one of the three to be: what you own is not of the same order as what you have thought. It is also the only one that is a right: without it, your humidor is unreadable by anyone else, by any path. What is shown is what the humidor holds and since when — never what it cost.
settings.showReviewsHint: If you untick it, your profile stops listing your public entries. They stay public: an « Everyone » entry stays on the cigar's sheet and in its average. It is the profile's display this setting decides, not the entry's scope.
settings.showCountryHint: Removes your country from your profile. The member directory is public by construction: this setting is a display, not a secret. To not appear at all, use « Appear in the directory » above.
settings.blockedLede: You no longer see anything they write, and they no longer see anything you write. You still see their profile, because one has to be able to come back on a decision one has made.
settings.privacyNotYet: All three have been honoured since P3. Two decide a display — your public entries stay public, your country stays in a public directory; what you set is what your profile shows of them. « Show my humidor » is the only one that is a right: unticked, your humidor is unreadable by anyone else, by any path.
settings.consentsLede: The register of what you have accepted, and when. A withdrawal is a new line, never an erasure: it is the history that makes the proof.
settings.consentsEmptyBody: Nothing has been recorded in it yet, and that is not an oversight: the terms and the privacy policy are not published, and no optional processing is in service. A tick box for processing that does not happen would manufacture a record, not a permission.
settings.basisContract: Contract — accepting the terms is not a choice we offer, it is what makes the service possible.
settings.basisLegal: Legal obligation — checking age before showing tobacco content.
settings.basisConsent: Consent — optional, revocable, and without effect on the rest.
settings.consentInactive: This processing does not happen today. The box will arrive with it.
settings.gdprLede: Articles 15, 17 and 20 of the GDPR, reachable from here. Nothing is deferred: both gestures run straight away.
settings.exportHint: A JSON file, structured and machine-readable, containing everything we hold about you — profile, settings, notebook, humidor, comments, reports, log. Nothing is cached.
settings.deleteHint: Erases the account and everything attached to it. What remains is what has to remain: the reference sheets you may have created lose their author instead of disappearing, and the audit log keeps the proof that this request was honoured.
settings.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete your account? Your notebook, your humidor, your comments and your settings go with it. This cannot be undone.
settings.deleteFailed: The deletion did not go through. Nothing has been erased.

errors.handleFormat: A handle is 3 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, digits and underscores, beginning and ending with a letter or a digit.
errors.displayNameTooLong: The display name is too long (60 characters at most).
errors.bioTooLong: The text about you is too long (400 characters at most).
errors.countryFormat: A country is written as two capital letters — FR, CU, NI.
errors.cityTooLong: The city name is too long (80 characters at most).
errors.unknown: This action did not go through.

boxCodes.title: Decode a box code
boxCodes.lede: Since 1985 the underside of a box of Havanas carries three factory letters, three month letters and two year digits. Type what you read, in any order.
boxCodes.inputLabel: The code, as it is printed
boxCodes.yearAmbiguous: Two digits read two ways: {year} is the likelier, {other} stays possible. Nothing in the code settles it.
boxCodes.factoryUnverified: Correspondence to be checked. The Cuban factory codes have been changed on purpose several times, and our table gives them with low confidence.
boxCodes.unknownLettersHint: Neither a month nor a code we know. We do not guess: offering a likely factory at the same level as a fact is what stops a reference being one.
boxCodes.otherDigitsHint: Often a lot or a series number. They carry no date.
boxCodes.nothingTitle: Nothing to read in that code
boxCodes.nothingBody: Neither letters nor digits. Copy what is printed under the box, spaces included: we will take care of the rest.
boxCodes.emptyBody: Type it above. Meanwhile the whole table is below: twelve months and six factory codes, with what we know of each.
boxCodes.tableLede: Eighteen rows, whose provenance is written in the repository. The twelve months are certain; the six codes are not.
boxCodes.caveatTitle: What this decoder does not do
boxCodes.caveatBody: It does not say whether a box is genuine. A legible, consistent code is forgeable; an illegible one proves nothing either. What it gives is a likely date of production — useful for knowing how long a box has been resting, and nothing else.

compare.title: Compare cigars
compare.lede: Two to four sheets side by side, on what the reference knows of them. What is missing is marked missing.
compare.emptyBody: Find a first sheet below. It takes at least two: comparing a sheet to nothing is reading it.
compare.full: Four sheets at most. Beyond that a table stops being readable: remove one to add another.
compare.needTwo: Add a second one for the comparison to mean anything.
compare.shareHint: This comparison is a URL: it copies, bookmarks and reopens exactly as it is.

contributions.title: Contribute to the reference
contributions.lede: A sheet is corrected by a proposal, which a reviewer accepts or refuses. Nothing is published without review, and nothing is erased: the history stays.
contributions.proposeLede: Fill in only what you want to change. What stays as it is does not enter the proposal.
contributions.proposeCommentHint: Optional, but it is what decides a reviewer. A source, a catalogue, a band in hand.
contributions.proposed: Proposal sent. It will appear in the review queue.
contributions.fieldFillerOriginsHint: Two-letter codes, separated by commas: CU, NI, DO.
contributions.noLinePublished: No published line for this brand. A line is born as a draft and is published by a reviewer — the field will open with them.
contributions.historyLede: Everything that has been proposed on this sheet, accepted or not, and why.
contributions.historyEmptyBody: Nobody has corrected it yet. If you see a mistake in it, now is the time.
contributions.mineLede: What you have proposed, and what became of it.
contributions.mineEmptyBody: A correction is proposed from the sheet to be corrected: the button is under its characteristics. 862 of the 940 sheets have no vitola — that is the most useful gap to fill.
contributions.queueLede: The proposals waiting, oldest first. A queue sorted the other way starves whoever has waited longest.
contributions.queueEmptyBody: Nothing to review. That is the right state, as long as someone comes to put something back in it.
contributions.notEditorBody: You can propose as many corrections as you like; accepting them requires the reviewer role. It is granted by hand, by an administrator, from your profile — there is no automatic threshold, and there will be none until somebody decides which one. What an administrator looks at is shown there: your reputation and the number of your accepted proposals.
contributions.decideCommentHint: Required for a refusal: it is the only thing the person who proposed will see.
contributions.withdrawConfirm: Withdraw this proposal? It disappears from the queue and from the history.
contributions.staleBody: One or more fields have been changed since this proposal: accepting it would silently overwrite that change. Fields concerned: {fields}.
contributions.newSheetBody: Not possible yet, and for a precise reason: the « created by » column is written on insertion and never changes afterwards, so a sheet created by a reviewer would carry their name and not yours. In a reference whose whole value is provenance, that is a lie one does not write lightly. The path needs a migration and a decision; it is flagged, not forgotten.

errors.nothingChanged: You have changed nothing. Change at least one field to propose something.
errors.countryFormat: A country is written as two capital letters — CU, NI, DO.
errors.commentTooLong: This comment is too long (1,000 characters at most).
errors.rejectionNeedsReason: A refusal needs a word: it is the only thing the author will see.
errors.stale: The sheet has changed since this proposal.
errors.lineUnknown: That line does not exist, is not published, or does not belong to this sheet's brand.
errors.alreadyDecided: This proposal has already been decided.
errors.newSheetUnsupported: Proposals for an entirely new sheet cannot be handled yet.
errors.notEditor: Deciding a proposal requires an editor role.
errors.duplicate: A sheet already carries this value.
errors.unknown: This action did not go through.
errors.unknownAroma: One of those aromas is not a descriptor of the wheel.
errors.sourceTooLong: The source is too long (500 characters at most).
errors.sourceFormat: A source fits on one line: an https address, or the reference of a published document.

contributions.closedBody: The revision queue is closed for the moment. Nothing you would have proposed is lost: there is simply nothing to send for now.
contributions.fieldAromaTagsHint: The descriptors of the wheel this sheet carries, twelve at most — Ctrl or Cmd to pick several. These are the reference's aromas, not those of a tasting: what one finds again from one box to the next.
contributions.fieldSourceHint: Optional. The address of the manufacturer's official page, or the reference of a published document. A source is stated when filing: it does not change afterwards, because a reviewer decides on what they have read.

feed.title: The feed
feed.lede: What the people you follow write, and what is newest on the site. Nothing here is private: a post is addressed to someone. What you keep to yourself is the notebook.
feed.followingLede: Your posts, and those of the people you follow.
feed.discoverLede: Everything open to everyone, newest first.
feed.emptyFollowingBody: You follow nobody, or nobody has written yet. Discover shows what the site publishes; that is where you find who to read.
feed.emptyDiscoverBody: The feed opens on what members write. The first line can be a note, a question, or the cigar you are smoking right now.
feed.emptyPageBody: There is nothing older than this date.
feed.backToStart: Back to the top of the feed
feed.cursorNote: The feed is read page by page, from the date of the last post you read — never by a page number, which would shift everything the moment a post arrives.

compose.bodyPlaceholder: What you noticed, what you are looking for, what you want to talk about.
compose.tooLong: A post is {max} characters at most.
compose.scopeFollowersHint: The people following you, at the moment they read.
compose.scopePublicHint: Every member, and any visitor who has passed the gate.
compose.scopeNote: A post cannot be private: writing for yourself is the notebook, and that is already what it does by default.

post.deleteConfirm: Delete this post? The embers and the comments go with it.
post.notFound: This post does not exist, or is not open to you.

comments.title: Comments
comments.empty: Nobody has replied yet. You can open the conversation.
comments.tooLong: A reply is {max} characters at most.

share.title: Post to the feed
share.lede: A notebook entry can be announced on the feed. The post keeps exactly the entry's audience, and follows it if you change it.
share.submit: Post this entry to the feed
share.already: This entry is already on the feed.
share.tooNarrow: An entry set to « Only me » or « People I name » cannot go to the feed: the feed has no recipient list. Open it to your followers or to everyone first.
share.scopeFollows: The post follows the entry's scope. If you close the entry back down to « My followers », the post leaves the feed.

session.title: Say you are smoking it
session.lede: A post on the feed, about this cigar. It is not a rating: the notebook is below, and it is private by default.
session.placeholder: Optional — the moment, the pairing, what you expect of it.

members.title: The members
members.lede: Those who have agreed to appear in the directory. You enter it by ticking « Appear in the directory » in your settings, and leave it the same way.
members.emptyBody: Nobody appears here yet. It is a choice each person makes in their settings, and a directory that showed everyone else would not be a directory.
members.searchEmptyBody: That handle returns nobody in the directory. Someone who does not appear there is still reachable at their profile address.
members.notFoundBody: No visible member carries this handle. It may have changed, or its holder may have left the directory.
members.roleLede: The role decides what this member can do. « Reviewer » opens the wiki contribution queue (§6); « Moderator » opens hidden content. The choice is yours: nothing here works out a threshold on your behalf, and reputation and accepted proposals are shown so that you can judge.
members.roleFailed: The role could not be changed.
members.roleForbidden: Only an administrator changes a role.
members.roleAdminLocked: An administrator's role is not changed from here. That is deliberate: a screen that can create the role operating it has no floor, and removing someone who could re-promote you is the gesture an interface must not offer.
members.roleTraced: Every change is written to the audit log, before and after. A right granted without a trace is a right nobody can check afterwards.
members.removeFollowerConfirm: Remove this person from your followers? They will stop reading your « My followers » entries and your restricted posts.
members.removeFollowerHint: Following is free: nobody asks your permission. Removal is what gives you the hand back.
members.blockConfirm: Block this person? You will see nothing of theirs, they will see nothing of yours, and any following between you is deleted.
members.blockedNotice: You have blocked this person. You no longer see what they post, and they no longer see what you post. Unblocking restores no following.
members.blockHint: A block is applied by the database, not by the display: it holds on every page, including those reached by a direct address.
members.postsEmpty: This member has posted nothing you can read.
members.reviewsHidden: This member does not show their notebook entries.
members.humidorHidden: This member does not show their humidor.
members.humidorEmpty: Their humidor is empty, or has nothing to show.
members.humidorNote: What the humidor holds, and since when. Never what it cost: a tobacco price does not cross a profile.

notifications.title: My notifications
notifications.lede: What other members have done that concerns you. Nothing here is written by you, and nothing can be: they are born of the gesture, not of a form.
notifications.emptyBody: Nobody has followed, given an ember or commented. This page will fill itself.

kind.review_share: {actor} named you on an entry of their notebook.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy
privacyPolicy.draft: This document describes what the site actually records, table by table, as of today. It has not yet been reviewed by legal counsel, and it will be before the public opening. What it describes, on the other hand, is verifiable: every section matches columns that exist, and the export of your data returns exactly those sources.
privacyPolicy.whoTitle: Who processes your data, and where
privacyPolicy.whoBody: The controller is the site's publisher, identified in the legal notice. The data is hosted with Supabase, in the eu-west-3 region (Paris), and the application with Vercel in the cdg1 region (Paris). No processor outside the European Union is involved to date. No audience measurement, no advertising tracker, no sharing with a third party: the cookie page says what the site sets, and it is short.
privacyPolicy.sensitiveTitle: A warning that comes first, because it changes all the rest
privacyPolicy.sensitiveBody: What you smoke, when, and how often is a tobacco consumption habit. Such data may be reclassified as health data within the meaning of article 9 of the GDPR. We assume that it is, and we build accordingly: every notebook entry is private by default, the scope is chosen entry by entry, and it is the database itself that applies it — not the display. In practice, an entry you have not opened up is readable by nobody but you, including by addressing the programming interface directly.
privacyPolicy.notebookBody: A notebook entry records the cigar, the date on which you smoked it, an optional rating from one to five bands, free text, and — for a structured tasting — six sub-scores, three thirds-of-the-cigar comments, the aromas noted, the strength perceived, the duration, the pairing, the box code, the production year, the year of purchase, the humidity, and whether the tasting was blind.
privacyPolicy.notebookScope: Every entry carries one of four scopes: you alone (the default), people you name one by one, your followers, or everyone. Only « everyone » entries enter a cigar's public average — a private entry moves no visible figure, which would be a way of deducing it.
privacyPolicy.notebookRevoke: Removing a recipient closes their future reading; it does not undo a past reading, and we will not pretend otherwise. The same principle holds for the « my followers » scope: following is free on this site, so the audience of an entry already written can grow without your being asked again. You can remove a follower at any time from their profile; their future reading closes.
privacyPolicy.humidorBody: A humidor records its name, its capacity, its humidity and temperature set points. A lot records the cigar, the quantity, the purchase date, the price paid, the seller, the date from which it is ageing, its location and a box code. The ledger records every movement — in, smoked, given, lost, adjusted, moved — with its date. The humidity readings record the measurement and the time.
privacyPolicy.humidorScope: All of this is strictly private by default. The « Show my humidor » setting opens to another signed-in member what your humidors hold — which cigars, how many, since when — and nothing else: neither what you paid, nor the ledger, and therefore not when you smoked what. This is not a display rule: the other columns stay unreadable whatever the path of access.
privacyPolicy.socialTitle: The social side — what you post
privacyPolicy.socialBody: A post records its text, its type, its scope, possibly the cigar or the notebook entry it speaks of, and its dates. An « ember » reaction records who, what and when. A post comment records its text and its author. A following records both people and the date. A block records both people and the date, and is never shown to the person blocked.
privacyPolicy.socialScope: A post is readable by your followers or by everyone — never private: writing for yourself is the notebook. Notifications record another member's gesture that concerns you; they are born of a database trigger and nobody can manufacture one.
privacyPolicy.socialDirectory: Your profile carries a handle, a display name, an introduction, a country, a city and a reputation. Unticking « Appear in the directory » removes you from what other members can look up, including the signature under your comments. The « Show my public entries » and « Show my country » settings decide what your profile page displays — they are display settings, not locks: an entry you have made public stays public on the cigar's sheet, and the member directory is public by construction.
privacyPolicy.referentialBody: A proposed correction records the field concerned, the value proposed, the source cited, its author and its outcome. A sheet comment records its text and its author; it is public by construction, since the sheet is.
privacyPolicy.legalContract: Article 6.1.b — performance of the contract: your account, your handle, your display preferences, and everything you write voluntarily. Without that, there is no service.
privacyPolicy.legalObligation: Article 6.1.c — legal obligation: the age check before any tobacco-related content, the consent register, the audit log, and the report queue required by the Digital Services Act.
privacyPolicy.legalInterest: Article 6.1.f — legitimate interest: moderation, the fight against abuse, and the rate limits that protect the service.
privacyPolicy.legalConsent: Article 6.1.a — consent: for optional processing. There is none in service today, so your consent register is empty, and that is normal. A tick box for processing that does not happen would manufacture a record, not a permission.
privacyPolicy.legalArticle9: If tasting data is qualified as health data, its processing rests on your explicit consent within the meaning of article 9.2.a — given by the gesture of writing an entry, and withdrawn by that of deleting it.
privacyPolicy.durationBody: As long as your account exists. Deleting it erases your profile, your settings, your notebook entries and their shares, your humidors and everything they hold, your posts, your embers, your post comments, your followings, your blocks and your notifications. Two exceptions, and they are deliberate: the audit log keeps the trace of the erasure request, stripped of your identifier — it is our proof of having honoured the request, and erasing it would erase the proof; and your contributions to the reference remain, likewise stripped of your name, because an encyclopaedic fact is not personal data even if its authorship is.
privacyPolicy.rightsTitle: Your rights, and how to exercise them
privacyPolicy.rightsBody: Access and portability (articles 15 and 20): « Download all my data » in your settings returns a JSON file containing each of the sources listed above, with no caching. Erasure (article 17): « Delete my account », in the same place, behind a written confirmation. Rectification (article 16): everything you have written can be changed where you wrote it. Objection and restriction (articles 18 and 21): through the contact point in the legal notice.
privacyPolicy.rightsExport: The export is not a capture of what the interface shows: it is built from the same list of sources as this document — {count} sources to date — and a test in the repository fails if a table pointing at an account is missing from it. That is how the list stayed true when the humidor and then the social side arrived.
privacyPolicy.changesTitle: What remains to be done, which we prefer to write down
privacyPolicy.changesBody: The contact point required by articles 11 and 12 of the Digital Services Act is not published yet: we will not announce an address while the corresponding mailbox does not exist, and the site's report form is the mechanism in the meantime. This document will be reviewed by legal counsel before the public opening, and dated at that moment.

journal.title: The journal
journal.lede: Learning something on every visit: the history, the terminology, the processes, the people. Nothing to sell, nothing to recommend — facts, sourced, and measurements.
journal.gatedTeaser: Other articles speak of particular sheets and live behind the gate.
journal.gatedTeaserLink: Pass the gate to read them
journal.emptyBody: The first articles are on their way. The RSS feed is already here: it will carry public articles only.

compose.title: Write for the journal
compose.lede: Reviewers only. An article is born a draft and behind the gate; making it public is a second gesture, and it forbids any linked sheet — the editorial charter applies to every line.
compose.reserved: The journal is written by reviewers. Contributing to the reference, on the other hand, is open to all — propose a correction from a sheet.
compose.draftsEmpty: No draft. The blank page is below.
compose.audienceGated: Behind the gate — may name sheets
compose.audienceNote: A public article can link no sheet, and the compliance sweep fails if it names a brand. Doubt is settled behind the gate.
compose.excerptHint: This is what the list, the RSS feed and the share card show — the body is never truncated into them.
compose.bodyHint: Bounded Markdown: ## and ### for headings, - for a list, > for a quotation, **bold**, *italic*, [text](https://…). Nothing else — and above all no HTML: anything unrecognised is displayed as it is.
compose.confirmDelete: Delete this article? Its links go with it.
compose.linksLegend: Linked sheets (article behind the gate only)
compose.linkCigarLabel: Link a cigar sheet (by its address)
compose.linkCigarHint: The sheet's slug, as it reads in its address: undercrown-10-robusto.
compose.linkOnPublic: A public article links no sheet. Move it behind the gate first.
compose.titleTooShort: A title is at least {min} characters.
compose.slugEmpty: That title leaves nothing for an address.
compose.slugTaken: An article already carries that address.
compose.audienceHasLinks: Remove the linked sheets first: a public article carries none.

gate.banner: This article lives behind the gate: it speaks of particular sheets.

venues.title: The partners
venues.lede: Tobacconists and smoking rooms, around you. No prices, no tobacco products — the welcome and the advice, never the counter.
venues.sourceNote: These addresses come from the official register of French tobacconists (customs, 2018, Open Licence): {count} places across mainland France. Some have closed since — report it and the sheet will move to « closed ».

list.locateFailed: Your position could not be read. It leaves your browser only if you start this yourself.
list.locateHint: Search by distance reads your device's position, at the moment you ask for it, and records it nowhere.
list.nearActive: Around you, within {km} km — nearest first.
list.countCapped: The first {count} places are shown. Narrow the search to see the rest.
list.emptyBody: No place is published for the moment. Propose yours: a tobacconist, a cellar, a lounge — the sheet will wait for a review before appearing.
list.noMatchBody: Try another name, another town, or widen the radius. And if the place is missing from the directory, propose it.
list.noneNearBody: No published and located place within this radius. Widen it, or propose the place that is missing.
list.locateCoarse: Your position is only known to within {km} km — too vague to search around you. On a computer, the browser often derives the position from the connection and lands on the operator's exchange. Allow precise location, or search by town name.
list.browseBody: The directory covers the whole of mainland France: search by name or by town, or let your device give its position to see what is nearby.

sheet.pendingBanner: Proposal waiting for review. It is visible only to you and to reviewers.
sheet.closedBanner: Reported closed. The sheet stays readable so that nobody proposes it again.
sheet.sourceLine: Sheet drawn from the official register of French tobacco retailers (DGDDI), 2018 vintage.
sheet.sourceInvite: Has something changed — closed, moved, renamed? Report the inaccuracy: the sheet will be corrected, or marked closed.
sheet.claimed: Sheet held by the professional running the establishment.
sheet.claimHow: Claiming a sheet will open with a contact channel able to check who you are. Until then, nothing is claimed in one click — deliberately: a public sheet is not taken on a declaration.
sheet.eventsEmpty: Nothing announced at this place for the moment.
sheet.editorNote: Publishing makes the sheet readable by everyone. Closing keeps it readable, marked closed.
sheet.confirmWithdraw: Withdraw this proposal? It will be deleted.
sheet.noGeo: This place has no coordinates: it does not appear in the search by distance.

reviews.title: The reviews
reviews.empty: No review for the moment. The first will say how one is received there.
reviews.guard: A review is about the welcome, the comfort and the advice. Never about the products — that is the rule of the house, and of the law.
reviews.bodyPlaceholder: How one is received, advised, seated.
reviews.criterionMissing: Rate all three: the welcome, the comfort, the advice.
reviews.confirmDelete: Withdraw your review of this place?
reviews.refused: The review could not be saved.
reviews.signedOut: Sign in to leave a review.

propose.title: Propose a place
propose.lede: A tobacconist, a cellar, a lounge, a table. The sheet will wait for a review before appearing — and what you do not know is left empty: a directory that guesses is no longer a directory.
propose.namePlaceholder: The name, as it reads on the front
propose.hoursSummary: Opening hours, if you know them
propose.hoursHint: One line per day, written out: « 09:00–19:00 », « closed ». Left empty, the sheet will say « not given ».
propose.positionHint: Optional. Without it, the place will not appear in the search by distance — the sheet will say so. « Use my position » is started from the place itself.
propose.locateFailed: Your position could not be read.
propose.nameTooShort: A place name is at least {min} characters.
propose.nameTooLong: A place name fits in {max} characters.
propose.cityMissing: The town is the minimum: without it, nobody finds anything.
propose.cityTooLong: A town name fits in {max} characters.
propose.postalInvalid: That postcode does not look like a postcode.
propose.websiteInvalid: A website starts with https:// (or http://).
propose.hoursDayTooLong: A line of opening hours fits in {max} characters.
propose.positionInvalid: Those coordinates are not on Earth.
propose.slugEmpty: That name leaves nothing for an address: add at least one letter or digit.
propose.refused: The proposal could not be sent.
propose.signedOut: Sign in to propose a place.
propose.positionCoarse: Your position is only known to within {km} km: it has not been copied across. Enter the coordinates by hand rather than putting a place in the wrong spot.

pending.ledeEditor: Publishing makes the sheet readable by everyone. §5.7 bounds the directory: a place, never a promotion.
pending.ledeMine: Visible to you and to reviewers only, until publication.

done.proposed: Proposal sent. It is waiting for a review.

clubs.title: The clubs
clubs.lede: A club is a group and a calendar. Meetings are announced there, people meet there — there is no feed inside: what one writes is read in the site's feed, where audience has a single meaning.
clubs.emptyBody: A club is created in one line: a name, and enough to say who it is for. The members come afterwards, freely.
clubs.membersLede: Joining is free, and so is leaving. The founder can remove someone — that is the counterweight, and it stays exercisable on both sides.
clubs.agendaEmpty: Nothing announced for the moment. A member of the club can propose a date.
clubs.notFoundBody: The link may be old, or the club may have been dissolved by its founder.

create.name: Club name
create.descriptionPlaceholder: Who it is for, where people meet, how often.
create.addressEmpty: The address is derived from the name.
create.nameTooShort: A club name is at least {min} characters.
create.nameTooLong: A club name is at most {max} characters.
create.descriptionTooLong: The description is at most {max} characters.
create.slugEmpty: That name gives no readable address. Add a letter or a digit to it.
create.slugTaken: A club already carries that address. Choose another name.

clubs.deleteConfirm: Dissolve this club? Its events disappear with it. This is final.

events.title: The events
events.lede: The tastings, the meetings and the visits announced by members. An event belongs to a club, or to nobody — both exist.
events.emptyBody: The calendar opens on what members propose. A date, a place written by hand, and it is announced.
events.placeNote: Choose a venue from the reference, or write it out in full — both read the same way on the announcement.
events.fullNote: The limit is indicative: nothing in the database refuses one more sign-up, and the host decides.
events.notFoundBody: The link may be old, or the event may have been cancelled by its host.
events.answerRefused: Answer refused. A block stands between you and the host, in one direction or the other.
events.cancelConfirm: Cancel this event? The answers disappear with it.

create.title: Title
create.descriptionPlaceholder: What is smoked, what to bring, how it works.
create.locationPlaceholder: The name of the place, and the address if it is not obvious.
create.titleTooShort: A title is at least {min} characters.
create.titleTooLong: A title is at most {max} characters.
create.descriptionTooLong: The programme is at most {max} characters.
create.locationTooLong: The place is at most {max} characters.
create.capacityRange: The number of places is between {min} and {max}.
create.endsBeforeStart: The end cannot come before the start.
create.membersOnly: Only a member of the club can announce an event in it.

messaging.title: The messages
messaging.lede: Conversations between two people, with those you follow or who follow you. Nothing more: a conversation has exactly two people.
messaging.notEncrypted: A message is not end-to-end encrypted, and the platform can read it. That is the counterpart of article 16 of the DSA: a reported message has to be examinable. A messaging service that let you believe otherwise would be worse than a frank one.
messaging.emptyBody: You write to someone you follow, or who follows you. That is the signal of consent: it already exists, it can be undone, and it leaves a trace.
messaging.noReachableTitle: Nobody to write to for the moment
messaging.noReachableBody: Follow someone, or let someone follow you, and the conversation becomes possible.
messaging.inboxFull: The {count} most recent conversations. There may be others.
messaging.notFoundBody: The link may be old, or it may not concern you.
messaging.markReadNote: Opening a conversation does not mark it read: a read receipt sent because a page was prefetched is a receipt that lies. Replying marks it read, and so does this button.
messaging.deleteConfirm: Delete this message? It disappears on your correspondent's side too.

compose.tooLong: A message is at most {max} characters.
compose.notLinked: You write to someone you follow, or who follows you.

shop.title: The shop
shop.lede: Cigar accessories, and nothing else: cutters, lighters, humidors, hygrometers, books. Every product is reviewed before going on sale, and the order runs through to payment — a demonstration one.
shop.emptyBody: Widen the search, or clear a filter: the shop is still young.
shop.shelfEmptyTitle: The shop is getting ready to open
shop.shelfEmptyBody: The shelves are filling up. Come back soon.
shop.reviewsEmpty: No review. A review will require a verified purchase — the promise is worth the wait.
shop.reportProductSignedOut: A problem with this product? Sign in to report it.

demo.label: Demonstration mode
demo.banner: Shop in demonstration mode — payment is fictitious: nothing is charged, nothing is shipped.

shop.demoPriceNote: Demonstration order: nothing is charged, nothing is shipped.

cart.title: The basket
cart.lede: What you are about to order. Everything can be changed here, up to the demonstration payment.
cart.emptyBody: Browse the shop: every product is added here, and the order can be tried all the way through.
cart.unavailable: Some items in this basket are no longer on sale; they have been left out.

checkout.title: Your details
checkout.lede: The delivery address for this demonstration order — nothing will be shipped, and nothing is kept beyond the confirmation.

errors.name: A full name, between 2 and 80 characters.
errors.cartEmpty: The basket is empty — the order has nothing to hold.

payment.title: Payment — demonstration
payment.lede: No payment provider is connected: the card is not charged, and no card data is kept or transmitted. Any card in the right format is accepted.

errors.cardNumber: Sixteen digits, as on the card.
errors.cvc: Three digits, on the back of the card.
errors.cartGone: The basket or the address have expired — start the order again from the basket.

confirmation.title: Demonstration order recorded
confirmation.status: Demonstration order recorded: nothing has been charged, nothing will be shipped.

sheet.privacyNote: The scope is chosen entry by entry. This sheet’s gesture starts public; an entry written from your notebook starts private.
sheet.signInTitle: Keeping a notebook needs an account
sheet.signInBody: What you smoked, when, the rating and the word. Everything starts private there; nothing is shared without your doing. The humidor and the full tasting come with it.

gesture.title: I’m smoking one
gesture.lede: A rating, a word if you have one. Nothing is required.
gesture.wordPlaceholder: What you take away from it.
gesture.decrement: Take one out of my humidor
gesture.decrementHint: Lot of {date} — {count} left. With no rating and no word, only the count is written.
gesture.decrementHintNoDate: {count} left. With no rating and no word, only the count is written.
gesture.announceHintOff: A post is addressed to someone: choose “My followers” or “Everyone”.
gesture.announceHintOn: Your followers — or everyone — will see that you are smoking it, with your word if there is one.
gesture.needsSomething: With no lot to draw from, an entry needs at least a rating or a word.
gesture.venueHint: Optional, and only if you say it on the feed: naming where one smokes is a confidence, never an obligation.
gesture.more: The rest — the date, the feed, the venue

circle.title: The Circle
circle.lede: What other people have smoked, and what they said about it.
circle.freeLine: Your notebook, your humidor, the reference, the shop.
circle.paidLine: And: the members’ notes, the feed, the clubs, the diary, the messages.
circle.plansNote: The Circle is not open yet: the till is waiting for its keys (ADR 0018). Until then everything is readable by every member, and nothing is charged.
circle.feedEmpty: Nothing has been posted yet. The first post will be yours.
circle.eventsEmpty: Nothing announced for the weeks ahead.
circle.journalLine: The part of the site that reads without an account.

suggestions.title: Five bands to try
suggestions.lede: Deduced from what you have smoked — the aromas you name, the strength and the ring gauge you keep coming back to. None of them is in your notebook already.
suggestions.emptyTitle: Your notebook has nothing to say yet
suggestions.emptyBody: Note one cigar — a rating in bands is enough — and this page will answer with what resembles it.
suggestions.reasonAromaOne: 1 aroma in common with your notebook
suggestions.reasonAromaMany: {count} aromas in common with your notebook
suggestions.reasonProfile: Close to your usual strength and ring gauge
suggestions.reasonPopular: The best rated, while your notebook has nothing to say
suggestions.ambianceCourt: Half an hour — a coffee, a break
suggestions.ambianceLong: An evening — two hours, sitting down
suggestions.ambianceUnknown: The format is not recorded, so the moment is anybody’s guess.
suggestions.howBody: Three measurements, in this order: the aromas your entries name (or, when they name none, the reference profile of the sheets you have smoked), your mean strength weighted by your ratings, your mean ring gauge. The members’ rating only breaks ties. One sheet per house: five bands from one house is one suggestion shown five times.
